recentItems.title: Arsenal vs Chelsea - The Last 11 Meetings 👀
recentItems.description:
Arsenal vs Chelsea - the last 11 meetings 👀

Ahead of our clash at Emirates Stadium, here’s a compilation of highlights from our last 11 meetings against Chelsea featuring a 5-0 win in 2023/24, a 2-4 victory in 2021/22, a last-minute goal from Kai Havertz in the Carabao Cup and many more!

This video features goals from Bukayo Saka, Martin Odegaard, Ben White, William Saliba, Jurrien Timber, Viktor Gyokeres, Mikel Merino, Martin Zubimendi, Declan Rice and many more!

What’s your favourite match against Chelsea? Let us know in the comments.

recentItems.title: Representing The Arsenal at Notting Hill Carnival ❤️ | Our supporters' stories 📘
recentItems.description:
Every year, Notting Hill Carnival brings together one of Britain's most significant celebrations of Caribbean culture and community.

Our connection with our Black and Caribbean community is something that has been forged for generations, through our players, legends and style of play. Arsenal has become a home for self-expression, personality and celebrating identity. A place where everyone belongs.

This year we took our mic stand into the streets of the Carnival to connect with supporters and capture authentic voices from the Caribbean community, providing a platform to share their stories of connection to our club, exploring what makes them feel a sense of pride and belonging.

Enjoy highlights, training, behind the scenes and documentaries to get closer to the likes of Bukayo Saka, Martin Odegaard, Alessia Russo, Leah Williamson, Kai Havertz, Gabriel Jesus, Kim Little, Declan Rice, Beth Mead, Gabriel Martinelli, Ben White, Stina Blackstenius and more.

recentItems.title: 250 Premier League Matches & Countless Memories! | Mikel Arteta’s Best Arsenal Moments
recentItems.description:
250 Premier League matches & countless memories! Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta has reached the incredible milestone of 250 games in Premier League management. 

To celebrate, we look back at some of the standout moments from his journey so far - from his first Premier League win in 2019/20 against Manchester United, to lifting the trophy after victory over Crystal Palace, a memorable win in his 250th match against Aston Villa and many more!

What’s your favourite Mikel Arteta moment as manager? Let us know in the comments.
